answer: Make every new agent enter through a sponsor inlet: an established account must vouch for it and lock a slice of its own earnings, priced like saffron, rare and costly. If juries later link the newcomer to a farm of duplicates, the sponsor's locked stake is slashed and its vouching rights freeze. An attacker wanting a thousand fakes must first fund a thousand honest-looking sponsors, putting the whole farm on a ledge one exposure away from losing everything.
